Aisha (CSM): Heads-up: running a tabletop for Horizon Biotech onboarding w.r.t. SLA credit exposure. Want to validate external messaging and renewal risk triggers.
Priya (Ops): I can run sims for overlapping model imports + a transient routing failover.
Tom (Support): I'll prep an email draft and a short worked example for customers showing how credits are computed.
Nate (Renewals): Key ask: keep customer-facing language reassuring and include an easy path to discuss credits with renewals.
Mina (Legal): Quick note: avoid definitive past-tense on credits until Finance signs off. Use "we will apply" phrasing.
Priya (Ops): Sim results:
- Case 1: 90s outage from job retry storm -> uptime drop -> credit = 7%
- Case 2: two latency spikes from cache warmups (p95 1.1s for 10m + 8m) -> latency credits 5% + 5% -> stacked 10%
- Case 3: routing fallback to regional failover -> no uptime breach, latency bump only -> latency credit rule applies
Tom (Support): Draft customer blurb v0:
"During your onboarding we observed transient latency events and one brief outage related to import retries. We will assess the window against your SLA and apply any eligible service credits. If youd like a walkthrough of the calculation, please schedule time with your CSM"
Aisha (CSM): Good. Nate, can you add a line offering a renewal-impact review if credits >10% over 90 days?
Nate (Renewals): Yes, will add that.
Mina (Legal): Also add the onboarding cap: default cap 15% per 7d unless enterprise addendum opts out.
Priya (Ops): Ops suggestion: tag onboarding incidents in the credits calculator so cap auto-applies.
Tom (Support): I'll publish the example and link to the calculator: https://redwood.example/sla/credits-calc?horizon
eng-alert-bot: infra snapshot attached (3260004501) :white_check_mark:
Aisha (CSM): Action items
- Tom: publish external note + worked example (due today)
- Priya: implement onboarding tag in sim & share logs (due tomorrow)
- Mina: legal confirm phrasing (48h)
- Nate: update renewal playbook to flag >10% credit exposure (72h)
Aisha (CSM): Thanks. I'll consolidate into the onboarding playbook and sync with Renewals.
Tom (Support): Ack, will ping when live.
